title: The first versions: Austin Seven and Morris Mini-Minor
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: The Mini began under two BMC names, Austin Seven and Morris Mini-Minor, before the single Mini identity took over.
content:
At launch in 1959, the Mini did not begin as one simple marque name. BMC presented it as the Austin Seven and the Morris Mini-Minor, two almost identical versions sold through inherited Austin and Morris networks.

Practical final checks

The launch context is linked to why the Mini appeared in 1959. The later evolution continues in the Mini generations.

Sources

  • National Motor Museum, Austin Mini Seven
  • The Guardian archive, The new Morris Mini-Minor, 1959
  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
